scoring_justification: Recompute slopes from the agent's raw CSV and compare to hidden reference slopes derived from the model; a full recompute of the final quantity is feasible from the submitted artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference slopes for dω₂D/dε and dFWHM₂D/dε derived from the shear‑lag + Raman model with ns=2, concentric laser spot, and the reference Raman coefficients given in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported experimental band shift rate (−12.8 cm⁻¹/%) and broadening rate (9.3 cm⁻¹/%) that the model (ns=2) is designed to reproduce; the model lines in Figure 7 pass through these data.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The slopes are the values the model predicts under the exact conditions of the task; they are not re‑measured here but taken as the established reference from the original publication.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the model’s target slopes as directly shown in the paper (Figure 7), not fabricated; an independent correct implementation of the model with the given parameters must produce slopes close to these.

outputs.description: CSV with model-predicted Raman 2D band peak position and width at varying applied matrix strains.

output_contract.notes: The verifier fits linear slopes ω₂D vs. strain and FWHM₂D vs. strain from the submitted table and compares them to hidden reference slopes derived from an independent correct implementation of the same model with ns=2.
